title: Key Vault: secrets, keys, certificates and rotation

videos.script: The shop's database password has to be somewhere. Not in the repository, not in the pipeline's settings, not in a parameter file. {{where}} Key Vault is where. The application reads it at run time, as its own identity, and nobody copies it anywhere. {{vault}} This lesson declares the vault, gives the application permission to read and nothing more, and has a key rotate itself every year. {{end}}
